title: 课程表
statement: 共有 numCourses 门课程，编号 0 到 numCourses - 1。prerequisites[i] = [a, b] 表示学习课程 a 之前必须先修完课程 b。判断是否能够修完全部课程，能则返回 true，否则返回 false。

en.title: Course Schedule
en.statement: There are numCourses courses, numbered 0 to numCourses - 1. prerequisites[i] = [a, b] means course b must be completed before taking course a. Determine whether all courses can be completed; return true if so, otherwise false.
constraints: All prerequisite pairs [a, b] are distinct

complexity.space: O(V + E) (adjacency list, in-degree array/queue, or DFS states and recursion stack)
complexity.notes: V = numCourses, E = prerequisites.length. Equivalent to checking whether a directed graph is acyclic: Kahn's topological sort pops all V vertices, or a three-color DFS finds no back edge.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is numCourses; line 2 is the number of prerequisite pairs p; then p lines, each of the form 2 a b (2 is the row length). stdout: true or false.

constraints: 所有先修关系 [a, b] 互不相同

complexity.space: O(V + E)（邻接表、入度数组/队列或 DFS 状态与递归栈）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: V = numCourses，E = prerequisites.length。等价于判断有向图是否无环：Kahn 拓扑排序能弹出全部 V 个点，或三色 DFS 未遇到回边。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 numCourses；第二行先修关系条数 p；随后 p 行，每行为 2 a b（2 是该行长度）。stdout：true 或 false。
